newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Danninger started with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Danninger started with buy.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc began coverage of Danninger Medical Technology Inc with a buy recommendation and a price target of $16 per share.
-- Rodman said its buy recommendation is based on Danninger's rapid growth in earnings per share following successful development of its spinal implant and rehabilitative device rental divisions.
-- Rodman said both platforms are experiencing increased revenue growth at higher margins than Danninger's core business, which is manufacturing rehabilitative devices.
-- Danninger's stock rose 3/8 Wednesday to close at 8-5/8.
